Independently constructed the 16x16 pair de Bruijn transfer matrix with characteristic polynomial t^11(t-2)(t-1)(t^3-t^2-2), yielding second moment 2^n+1+s_n. The sum, first moment, second moment and triple count solve the four C_{n,j}; directly checked all 8190 output words for n=1..12. Exact finite matrix identity and semigroup closure, not only bounded enumeration, prove all n.
